bounds.domain: Two tab identities, a withdrawn selection, one site permission kind, and one pending request. A changed visit or document retires the captured request until a fresh admission. Main-thread actions are atomic.
bounds.conformance: Twelve controlled JVM schedules execute the selected-presentation updater and permission callback from the exact BrowserTabHostPlugin source. Controlled ports hold Android results and dialog buttons, including a tab switch during a denial notice in a two-kind result.
bounds.limits: The model projects permission lists to one grant. This excludes Android WebView and ActivityResultRegistry behavior, physical sensors, platform reentrancy beyond the denial-notice schedule, private-tab record behavior, and OS time limits.

assumptions: Weak fairness of a continuously pending Android result. Android may grant or deny. A missing platform result or a wall-clock deadline is outside this obligation.
